name: Mr. Chen's Triangle Bridge Lesson
description: Use Mr. Chen's bridge presentation to compare bridge types, name the main bridge parts, and explain why triangular trusses keep the rebuilt dry-wash crossing from folding.

steps.description: Watch Mr. Chen's bridge presentation: bridges carry people over streams, ravines, and roads by giving forces a safe path to the ground.
Compare beam, arch, frame, cable-stayed, suspension, and combination bridges.
Name the superstructure, abutments, and intermediate substructure or pier on the bridge sketch.
Explain why triangle braces resist racking while rectangles can lean into a parallelogram.
Trace the deck load through triangle braces into supports, abutments, and stable ground.
Talk to three grateful neighbors near the new bridge.
Cross the bridge to unlock the new area.
